Metalabion

A downloadable Metalabion for Windows

About the game

Metalabion - is a methamphetamine cooking simulator made in the style of "Retro" with elements of Physics and Sandbox, where you have to completely go through all the cooking stages from the beginning to the end.

Disclaimer

This is a fan-made parody game created by de_reconnect & cNact. It is not affiliated with AMC, Breaking Bad, or any of their associated entities. The game is not intended for commercial purposes or financial profit and is available exclusively on itch.io. The developers strongly condemn the sale and use of drugs - everything depicted in this game is entirely fictional.

Description

The story follows the process of cooking methamphetamine in Gustavo Fring's laboratory. You play as Walter White and your goal is to complete one of the daily quotas, which is set at 250 money.

You enter the lab, turn on the lights near the door, and begin cooking meth. There are 7 stages in total, and they must be completed in sequential order: from Stage 1 through Stage 7.

However, there are some challenges - like needing to refill electricity under the stairs, making sure you eat food, and managing your limited time of 11 minutes.

Each full cooking cycle adds 2 extra minutes, so if you're efficient, you can stay ahead of the clock.

Gameplay

An average playthrough takes around 5-10 minutes, but there’s plenty of extra content and unusual systems that can keep you coming back.
